answer.message: Claude Code is signed out on runner "orbit-managed" — every session started there fails immediately. Sign in from Infrastructure, or run `claude auth login` on that machine, then start this session again.

display.detail: The runner is up, but none of its runtimes is installed and signed in, so it cannot start a session. Sign one in from Infrastructure; a runner that has stopped waiting for it can then be retried.
